facts.text: Uncle Dave built this park for families, so the snack stand had better be good. I'll take the biggest hot dog.
facts.why: Invented line signed Axel Foley. The film's Axel never says it. His real lines at the park include 'Yeah I'm ok, just don't let go' while hanging off the Spider ride.
facts.fix: Yeah, I'm okay, just don't let go.

fix_note.text: Yeah, I'm okay, just don't let go.

facts.text: Rosewood's order, back on duty at Wonder World.
facts.why: Nothing I opened (Wikipedia plot, Wikiquote, TV Tropes) shows Rosewood ordering a frozen lemonade, or any drink. He is back on duty at the park, which is true.
facts.fix: Rosewood, back on duty at Wonder World.

facts.text: Rosewood back in action with a shotgun
facts.why: No source I opened mentions a shotgun. Wikipedia only says Axel, Rosewood and Flint are injured in the final shootout.
facts.fix: Rosewood back in action with Axel at the park

vibe.verdict: A tidy theme park snack stand with the Spider ride cue, but it plays the film polite and leaves out its funniest props.
